title: Prescribed normalized CE row presentations
statement: For simultaneous prescribed augmented CE bicomplexes I,a on schemes X and bounded-below complexes K [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], assume individual lower bounds, quasi-isomorphic augmented rows, injective terms and horizontal cycles, boundaries and homology, and quasi-isomorphisms on their augmentations. There exist presentations P retaining I, positive-page differentials δ [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential] and page isomorphisms j. Every transported successor comparison is normalized [lem-sp-filtered-complex-normalized-homology], and j inverse followed by firstPageIso equals the concrete signedRowComparison [def-weil-pbc-ce-canonical-row-comparison] followed by ceRowOrdinaryIso [lem-weil-pbc-ce-row-ordinary-naturality]. No scheme-map representative naturality is asserted.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homological Algebra
source.place: Tags 015J, 015K, 0130 and 012K; normalized CE pages and diagonal row representatives

proof.text: Use cartanEilenberg_second_filtration to obtain the prescribed second filtration, its graded page zero and the finite image-filtration transport. Use cartanEilenberg_total_resolution, the canonical grothendieckKInjectiveResolutionChoice, CochainComplex.KInjectiveResolution.homotopyEquiv and homotopyEquivHomotopy and cartanEilenberg_mapped_total_iso to construct the augmentation, comparison and sections map with their summand equations. Compose its homology isomorphism with resolutionEtaleCohomologyIso and apply the image-filtration transport to this specific composite.

Choose the uniquely specified representative differential on each positive concrete quotient page. Adjoin the existing graded page zero using filteredComplex_graded_homology. Define every positive successor comparison by conjugating the unique normalized homology isomorphism with the page-equality isomorphisms. The transport back cancels these isomorphisms and gives normalization. The degreewise second-filtration step is zero in negative complementary degrees; its graded quotient, cycles and page cokernel are then zero.

Retrieve the canonical row comparison and its step, cycle and homology-projection equations. Apply the representative differential to the row cycles and the explicit total differential calculation row_cycle_total_d; cancel the epic cycle-to-page projection. Multiply by (-1)^(pq), whose successive ratio is (-1)^p, to remove the totalization sign. Compose with the inverse injective-row isoRightDerivedObj and use its naturality to prove dDerived.

Prove coefficient naturality of ceRowOrdinaryIso locally: reuse the proved extClass_naturality and classSectionsIso_naturality implementation lemmas, then the natural mapExtendIso and extendHomologyIso equations. Compose their four commutative squares with CommSq.vert_comp and cancel the inverse comparisons with CommSq.vert_inv, without unfolding the comparison data in the simplifier. Compose isoRightDerivedObj with this explicit ordinary comparison and use right-derived naturality to obtain ordinary_naturality. Assemble all presentation fields. The inverse and hom of the row-resolution comparison cancel, leaving precisely signedRowComparison followed by ceRowOrdinaryIso. Choose the pointwise witnesses simultaneously; the prescribed bicomplex remains definitionally unchanged. No new unproved statement is used.

proof_origin.place: Repair of the quarantined normalized CE presentation proof: package the total and canonical resolutions as KInjectiveResolution, use homotopyEquiv and homotopyEquivHomotopy, then apply the unchanged mapped-total, normalized-page and signed-row construction.

theorem exists_etaleCE_normalized_row_presentations
    (I : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      HomologicalComplex₂ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ((CochainComplex.single₀
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
         (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ I X K)
    (hbelow : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero ((I X K).X s))
    (hrows : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ), QuasiIso ((a X K).f s))
    (hterms : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((I X K).X s).X r))
    (hhorizontal : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
      Injective (((I X K).cycles s).X r) ∧
      Injective ((image ((I X K).d (s - 1) s)).X r) ∧
      Injective (((I X K).homology s).X r))
    (hquasi : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ),
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (a X K) s) ∧
      QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' ((a X K).f (s - 1)) ((a X K).f s)
        ((a X K).comm (s - 1) s))) ∧
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a X K) s)) :
    ∃ (P : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (δ : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        FilteredComplexPageDifferential (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r)
      (j : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r), (P X K).sequence.page r hr ≅ (δ X K r hr).page),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        (P X K).I = I X K) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ),
        FilteredComplexHomologyNormalized (P X K).sectionsTotal (P X K).L r (δ X K r hr) pq
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}
            (ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)) pq).mapIso (j X K r hr).symm ≪≫
            (P X K).sequence.iso r (r + 1) pq rfl hr ≪≫
            (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}
              (ComplexShape.up' (r + 1, 1 - (r + 1))) pq).mapIso
                (j X K (r + 1) (by omega)))) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        (j X K 1 (by omega)).inv.f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((P X K).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((P X K).signedRowComparison p q).hom ≫
            (ceRowOrdinaryIso X (K.obj.X q) (cePresentationRow (P X K) q) p).hom)
